thread:
sam (Design): quick design check 1 11 proposing small wording + flow changes for Create/Rotate/Revoke. Key goals: cut CTA noise, make revoke meaning obvious, and surface a short re-open for users who close too fast. mock: https://imgur.com/newmock

jules (Frontend): agree. Primary action = Copy. Hide Download under "More" on narrow screens. Keep focus on Copy on open.

lee (A11y): ensure secret field has aria-describedby pointing to the warning text. Make the re-open link keyboard-focusable. Use aria-live assertive for copy/revoke toasts.

marta (Product): ken 1 any data on lost-key tickets?

ken (Support): ~40% of key-support tickets come from users who closed modal. A 60s re-openable drawer or snackbar reduces them. Also users misunderstand "revoke" as permanent deletion.

sam (Design): proposed revoke copy: Headline: "Revoke API key" Subline: "Stops this key immediately. Restorable for 24 hours." Add KB link and an Undo toast for 30s.

jules (Frontend): Undo via toast ok. For rotate, add optional "1-hour overlap" checkbox with textual fallback for SRs. We'll send analytics for overlap usage.

lee (A11y): timeline needs readable text: "Old key active until [time]." sliders must have number inputs + labels. Icons need aria-labels.

marta (Product): plan: Sam update mocks, Jules add aria attrs + branch, Lee review, Ken draft KB wording.

deploy-bot: build queued for branch "feat/key-ux-revoke-overlap" 1 build 8240 started. :rocket:
